name: Arched Gateway Sign
summary: Neutral curved entrance portal with a separately editable blank sign band and an unobstructed walking opening.
description: Original structural half-ellipse on two pillars with shallow anchored feet, graphite reveals and a blank rectangular sign band. Add scene-owned text to the separate SIGN_Band node or SIGN_TextAnchor; no lettering, logos or downloaded assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and shared PBR materials; no external assets, images, textures, fonts or brands.
origin: Floor centre of the symmetric outer footprint; root at [0,0,0].

opening.method: Ground-level jamb extremities; overhead triangle clipping across full width; open rectangular volume clipped against every exported triangle, 10 micrometre boundary tolerance.

material_notes: Three shared opaque materials: Frame neutral mineral, Sign band warm white, Trim graphite. Source components stay editable; export groups them into three meshes. Studio floor, lights and camera excluded.
accuracy_notes: Original visual portal; not a load-bearing, code-compliant or accessibility-certified design. Aperture measured from delivered triangles, with no colliders or walking controller. Full 17-shop mall assembly, physical devices and sustained performance not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
